# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Data Plane - Actions API Reference — RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-26

## OPERATION-FOR-OPERATION IDENTICAL TO THE 2026-08-07 CAPTURE.
## THIRD CONSECUTIVE VERIFICATION WITH NO NET-NEW DATA-PLANE OPERATIONS (08-07, 08-24, 08-26).

Memory: BatchCreateMemoryRecords, BatchDeleteMemoryRecords, BatchUpdateMemoryRecords,
  DeleteMemoryRecord, GetMemoryRecord, ListMemoryRecords, ListMemoryExtractionJobs,
  RetrieveMemoryRecords, StartMemoryExtractionJob
Auth/Token: CompleteResourceTokenAuth, GetResourceApiKey, GetResourceOauth2Token,
  GetResourcePaymentToken, GetWorkloadAccessToken, GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT,
  GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId
Events: CreateEvent, DeleteEvent, GetEvent, ListEvents
Agent/Runtime: GetAgentCard, InvokeAgentRuntime, InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand, InvokeHarness,
  StopRuntimeSession, DeleteCapacityProviderSession
Browser: GetBrowserSession, ListBrowserSessions, SaveBrowserSessionProfile, StartBrowserSession,
  StopBrowserSession, UpdateBrowserStream, InvokeBrowser
Code Interpreter: GetCodeInterpreterSession, InvokeCodeInterpreter, ListCodeInterpreterSessions,
  StartCodeInterpreterSession, StopCodeInterpreterSession
Registry: SearchRegistryRecords   <- STILL THE ONLY REGISTRY OP ON THIS PAGE
A/B Testing + Batch Evaluation + Recommendation: CreateABTest, DeleteABTest, GetABTest, ListABTests,
  UpdateABTest, DeleteBatchEvaluation, GetBatchEvaluation, ListBatchEvaluations, StartBatchEvaluation,
  StopBatchEvaluation, DeleteRecommendation, GetRecommendation, ListRecommendations, StartRecommendation
Payments: CreatePaymentInstrument, CreatePaymentSession, DeletePaymentInstrument, DeletePaymentSession,
  GetPaymentInstrument, GetPaymentInstrumentBalance, GetPaymentSession, ListPaymentInstruments,
  ListPaymentSessions, ProcessPayment
Additional: Evaluate, ListActors, ListSessions

## THE SEPARATE `agent-registry` API SURFACE — grew this scan (see the changelog cache)
Not on this page. Now known to include, at minimum:
  Control plane: GetRegistry, UpdateRegistry, DeleteRegistry, PutResourcePolicy,
                 CreateRegistryRecord, UpdateRegistryRecord, DeleteRegistryRecord, GetRegistryRecord,
                 ListRegistryRecords, SubmitRegistryRecordForApproval, UpdateRegistryRecordStatus
  Data plane:    SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecords, GetDiscoverableRegistryRecord,
                 ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords, BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord,
                 **InvokeRegistryMcp**
  Condition keys: agent-registry:RecordCreatorAccount, agent-registry:RecordSourceAccount
CLI namespaces observed: `aws agent-registry ...` (data plane) and `aws agent-registry-control ...`.
=> **THIS SURFACE, NOT THE AGENTCORE DATA-PLANE PAGE, IS WHERE REGISTRY CHANGES LAND. Watch it
   separately; the AgentCore Actions page has been static for three verifications running.**

Gateway rate-limit ops (CreateRateLimit, GetRateLimit, UpdateRateLimit, DeleteRateLimit,
ListRateLimits, BatchPutRateLimitEntries) are control-plane and not listed on this page.

Updated: 2026-08-26 — no change. Registry activity is happening on the agent-registry surface instead.
